scope: Theorem 10.4 (Compact realization of fresh-tail cylinders) of the manuscript “Incompressible Box Transport and Finite Computation” (preprints/Incompressible-Box-Transport-and-Finite-Computation-October-6-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 376 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2505dc09d3f2c24b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 37. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The fresh-tail recorder has an effective compactly supported smooth realization on R3, with zero initial velocity and force periodic after one unit of loading, whose event ∃t ≥ 0 : (Φt(0))1 < −1 is equivalent to halting. A separate choice, with the same event and one compact support, satisfies for every k ≥ 0 and spatial multi-index α sup x |∂k t ∂α x u| + |∂k t ∂α x F|  ≤ Ck,α(1 + t)−1−k . (32) Every displayed derivative is space-time square-integrable. Both forces have the unique zero-pressure solution of Lemma 7.3 at the fixed computable viscosity.
